tandemFrageBeispiel.frage: Comment est-ce que je vais à la gare ?

tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “Est-ce que je peux entrer ?” The blue tile is the infinitive: you make the imperative.

B hears the question and builds the answer. The first small tile (tu, vous or nous) says who is told to act: it is not written. The imperative is the present without the subject: tu prends → Prends, vous prenez → Prenez, nous prenons → Prenons. -er verbs lose the s with tu (tu parles → Parle). Irregular: être (Sois, Soyez, Soyons), avoir (Aie, Ayez, Ayons), aller (Va, Allez, Allons).

Negative: “ne … pas” goes around the verb (Ne fumez pas). With a pronoun tile (le, lui) the pronoun comes after the verb in the positive (Prends-le, Téléphone-lui) and a reflexive verb uses toi, nous, vous (Dépêche-toi !). Then B asks question 2 and A answers. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Finally: swap cards and do it all again, faster.
